newsitem.title: ESTONIA: INDEX HITS NEW HIGH, HANSA SETS RECORD TURNOVER.
newsitem.headline: INDEX HITS NEW HIGH, HANSA SETS RECORD TURNOVER.

text.p: * Total trade at 198.7 million kroons vs 159.75 million
kroons.
* Index reaches a new high up 2.98 percent to 430.53.
* 26 stocks traded: 14 up, 9 down, 3 steady.
* Hansapank the most active, gains 0.5 kroons to
close at 219.5 kroons in record trade of 102 million kroons.
* Uhispank picks up 11.1 kroons to close at a new
high of 116.1 kroons in trade of 31.7 million kroons.
(See the stock exchange web site: http://www.tse.ee/stat/)
The bulls returned to the
Estonian bourse on Monday with banking stocks, led by
Hansapank, taking it to new highs.
Total trade on the main list was a huge 196.7 million
kroons as the Talse index gained 2.98 percent to end at 430.53.
"It was a bullish market, but there was no big news to
encourage the trade," one dealer said.
"We are seeing foreign investors selling and local investors
buying, but we don't expect this to last for long," another
trader said.
Hansapank was the most active stock with 102 million kroons
traded to gain 0.50 kroons for a close of 219 kroons.
"Hansapank made some strong gains in morning trade with
local buying interest keeping the stock higher," a trader said.
Both local and foreign buying interest in Uhispank took it
to a record of 116.5 kroons, an increase of 11.1 kroons with
31.7 million kroons traded.
The stock also gained 10 kroons last Friday.
"There are still no sellers in Uhispank, so the price just
keeps on rising," a dealer said.
On the free market trade was low with only 1.9 million
kroons traded as interest was firmly focused on the main list.
Privatisation vouchers were the most active with
only 595,202 kroons turned over.
Privatisation securities were up to 0.423 kroons from 0.416
kroons.
